div.head: ECf 6.1
div.ab: Et si infra triginta et unum diem per amicos suos seu per iusticiam regis reperiri non poterit, ore suo utlagabit eum rex.

not the Frankish de sermone (‘out of the peace’, Brunner, DRG. II 42, Pollock, Engl. hist. rev. 1893), but literally: the judge outlaws in his own person, not through his officer, in German law too; Frensdorff, Recht und Rede, in Hist. Aufs. dem And. an Waitz 474. The Retractator only brings the expression closer to the Vulgate (Job 23, 12)
